high_level_description: This image shows the storefront of a store named "Bahart," which appears to be a branch of a larger company called "Food House LLC." The signboard is prominently displayed at the top of the storefront, featuring the name "Bahart" in large, green Arabic script with a stylized leaf design incorporated into the lettering. Below the name, there is smaller text in both English and Arabic, indicating that it is a branch of Food House LLC. The storefront itself has a modern and clean appearance. The glass windows display various products on shelves inside the store.
